contractLead: Describe what you need in ordinary words. We parameterize a reviewed Solidity template (OpenZeppelin patterns). Gas is paid in PPL. Token/NFT factory remains the built-in path.

hub.title: Create a token, NFT, or contract
hub.subtitle: No code for tokens and NFTs. For general-purpose contracts, write a sentence and review the Solidity before you sign.

token.title: Create a token
token.lead: Standard Token Factory launch: name, ticker, supply, image, then pay the PPL fee.

nft.title: Create an NFT
nft.lead: Mint a unique item with a picture, name, and description. Optional collection name groups pieces.

form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Upload a file or paste a link to an image. You will see a preview first.
form.name: Name
form.feeUnset: Fee amount is unavailable because the configured value is invalid.
form.allocation: Standard launch split (fixed by the protocol): 60% curve, 10% community, 15% creator, 10% liquidity, 5% ecosystem.
form.success: The network accepted the signed transaction.
form.stableFeeBuybackNote: Paid 100% into the public PPL buyback.
form.stableFeeNetworkNote: Works on the People network only for now. Paying from another chain (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, TON, Solana) is coming later.
form.leftoverHint: Choose what happens to tokens still on the bonding curve when it migrates to the AMM, or if the curve does not sell out within 180 days. Never to you (the creator) and never to the protocol treasury.
form.leftoverBurnHint: Default. Leftover and unsold tokens are permanently burned.
form.leftoverPoolHint: Send leftover and unsold tokens to this token's own community pool.
form.launchSummary: When you launch: 10% of supply goes to your token's community pool. You choose whether curve leftovers after AMM migration and unsold tokens at 180-day finalize are burned (default, recommended) or sent to that community pool — never to you or the treasury. Optional referral share: default 5% of supply (max 10%), invite bounty 5%.

iconGen.lead: Pick a style, describe your idea in a few words, and choose one of four pictures.
iconGen.verifiedOnly: Free tries are only for founders verified via Telegram or Human Passport.
iconGen.paidNote: After free uses: {fee} PPL per try
iconGen.pickHint: Tap one to use as your picture
iconGen.connectWallet: Connect your wallet on the Pay step first, or open Wallet and return here.
iconGen.errorGeneric: Could not create pictures. Try again.
